select p.id programId, p.author_brand_id authorBrandId, p.title, p.thumbnail, p.description, p.online_link onlineLink, p.work_mode workMode, p.topics, p.buzz, p.applys, p.attendees, p.status, p.created_at createdAt, b.brand_name authorName, b.avator authorAvatar, b.location authorIpLocation, b.customer_id authorUserId, CASE WHEN a.id IS NOT NULL THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS applied from coop_programs p inner join brand b on p.author_brand_id = b.id left join coop_applications a on p.id = a.program_id and a.applicant_brand_id = #{currentBrandId}
p.status != 'freeze'
and (locate(#{dto.q}, p.title) > 0 or locate(#{dto.q}, b.brand_name) > 0 or json_contains(p.topics, concat('"', #{dto.q}, '"')))
and p.work_mode = #{dto.workMode}
order by p.applys desc
order by p.buzz desc
order by p.created_at desc

select p.id programId, p.author_brand_id authorBrandId, p.title, p.thumbnail, p.description, p.online_link onlineLink, p.work_mode workMode, p.topics, p.buzz, p.applys, p.attendees, p.status, p.created_at createdAt, b.brand_name authorName, b.avator authorAvatar, b.location authorIpLocation, b.customer_id authorUserId, CASE WHEN a.id IS NOT NULL THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS applied from coop_programs p inner join brand b on p.author_brand_id = b.id left join coop_applications a on p.id = a.program_id and a.applicant_brand_id = #{currentBrandId} where p.id = #{programId}
